subject: general
question:
Consider the given statement and the following assumptions and decide which of the assumption(s) is/are implicit in the statement.

**Statement:**

Children share their feelings more with their friends than with their parents.

**Assumptions:**

I. Children feel that their friends will be able to understand their feelings better than their parents.

II. Children are not friendly with their parents nowadays.

options.text: Neither assumption I nor II is implicit.
Both assumptions I and II are implicit.
